title: Bug reproduced in checkout (sympy 1.5.dev): b._blockmul(b)._blockmul(b) fails because block products collapse ZeroMatrix entries to scalar Zero (is_Matrix=False), unlike fixed sympy 1.14 where they stay ZeroMatrix
evidence_refs: run_command: checkout probe Add(z,z)->Zero scalar vs 1.14 Add(z,z)->ZeroMatrix; blocks*blocks entries is_Matrix=False in checkout, True in 1.14

title: Fixed: minimal upstream fix (PR #17630) applied to sympy/matrices/expressions/matexpr.py — Add postprocessor returns MatAdd(*matrices) directly when no scalar args, so ZeroMatrix blocks no longer collapse to scalar Zero; all TASK.md examples now pass
evidence_refs: run_command: after edit, checkout sympy 1.5.dev prints Add(z,z)=ZeroMatrix, b._blockmul(b)._blockmul(b)=Matrix([[a**3,0],[0,0]]), block_collapse(b*b*b)=Matrix([[a**3,0],[0,0]]) — all issue examples pass
